summary: Verifier for Menus & client flow (2026-11-07). Both majors reproduce on the current build. 1) Role and preset sit below the fold: my own pw.mjs probe (_harness/_reports/closing2v_client_roles.json, shots _harness/_shots/closing2v_client_roles_*) found 0 role or preset chips visible above the CTA bar for Quick, Draft and Lantern Drill at both 1920 and 1280. 2) The Draft/Ranked ban goes to the team's first seat. Code proves it: draft.ts:454-460 deals it to mine[0]; local_session.ts:442 gives the human a random seat; draft.ts:304-305 rejects a non-holder's ban with 'no_ban'; draft.tsx:356/379 prompts with myBans.length, which is done bans only. Minors were spot-checked in code and all stand: MSAA option against quality.ts:102 and ruling 25, the user icon at app.tsx:380, 'Ready in {t}' at queue.tsx:109, concurrent animateIn/animateOut at app.tsx:465-484. No blocker and no sensitivity issue in any menu shot I viewed. Load was 20-41, so timing is not_measured. The 7.6 score stands: ON PAR under ruling 8, with 2 majors in the backlog.

Settings slice only. Accessibility tab strings at content/strings.en.json:1575-1577; defaults at settings.ts:68. The in-match effect is the HUD lens's.

Settings slice only. 'Ambient life' toggle is on by default. The in-world effect is the environment lens's.

findings.title: Play hides the role and preset choice below the fold at 1920 and 1280
findings.what: RolePicker and PresetPanel render after the four long queue cards (play.tsx:121-128). At both supported sizes they sit under the scroll edge and behind the Find match bar.
findings.evidence: Independent probe: _harness/_reports/closing2v_client_roles.json. CTA bar top is at 976 (1920) and 630 (1280). Visible chips above it: 0 for QUICK, DRAFT and LANTERN DRILL at both sizes. First chip top: 945/973 at 1920, 598/621 at 1280. Shot _harness/_shots/closing2v_client_roles_1920_QUICK.png shows 'CHOOSE BEFORE YOU QUEUE' with the FIGHTER row cut off by FIND MATCH.
findings.fix: Shorten the queue cards to title, chip and reward (the detail panel already carries the prose). Dock the primary/secondary role pair, or Quick's fighter/role pair, in the CTA bar. Add a fold check to sweep_720.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced with my own capture. The column scrolls, so this is not a blocker. But a queue's required choice off-screen at 1920 is a real friction major against the LoL lobby, where the position choice sits next to Find Match.
findings.gauge: LoL lobby keeps the position selectors on screen next to Find Match.

findings.title: Draft/Ranked ban belongs to seat 0; the human is told to ban but usually cannot
findings.what: buildBans deals the team's one ban to mine[0] (draft.ts:454-460). The human's seat is rng.int (local_session.ts:442), so the human holds the ban about 1 time in 5. The prompt ignores d.turn and always says 'Your team bans {n}. Pick a fighter to ban.' with n = done bans = 0 (draft.tsx:356, 369, 379). Once the human hovers, the BAN button enables (reason is null), but the host rejects a non-holder with 'no_ban' (draft.ts:304-305). The bot holder bans at once, so the phase ends about 1.5 s in.
findings.evidence: Code lines above. The reviewer's live run (_harness/_reports/closing_client2_cap.json draftPhases) shows ban at 8.8 s and pick at 10.3 s, with the human at seat 3.
findings.fix: In bot-filled teams, deal the ban to the human seat. Give bot ban-holders a 3-6 s beat. Prompt from d.turn ('You hold your team's ban' versus '{name} bans for your team'). Pass bansForRoster as {n}. Add an e2e assertion that the human can ban.
findings.verifierNote: Verified in code. Severity is right: in a competitive queue, a ban control that invites the action and then refuses it reads as broken. Not a blocker, because the draft still completes.
findings.gauge: LoL draft: each banning player has their own ban turn, and the client says whose turn it is.

findings.title: Deluxe skins still read as base re-tints at stage size
findings.what: Residual of CL-1. The gate passes 32/32 and plinth ΔE is 17-20, but the accents are not legible.
findings.evidence: Reviewer ΔE crops on closing_client2_1920_* shots; gen_store --check 32/32.
findings.fix: One large material accent per deluxe skin (within ruling 19) and a higher ΔE floor.
findings.gauge: Higher LoL skin tiers change more than colour.

findings.title: Screen transitions overlay two screens of text
findings.what: animateIn and animateOut run at the same time.
findings.evidence: src/ui/app.tsx:465-484 (in: useLayoutEffect on shown; out: concurrent animateOut); _harness/_shots/closing_client2_motion_play_40ms.png.
findings.fix: Fade the leaving layer out within 90 ms before the entering text staggers in.
findings.gauge: The LoL client does not superimpose two screens' text.

findings.title: Key art is daylight against the dusk client
findings.evidence: Luma figures on closing_client2_1920_home.png; the Play map card in closing2v_client_roles_1920_QUICK.png is bright midday.
findings.fix: Dusk regrade plus a luma gate.
findings.gauge: LoL keeps one graded mood per client theme.

findings.title: Settings offers MSAA, which silently maps to SMAA
findings.what: The segmented control offers off/smaa/msaa, and the renderer maps msaa to smaa.
findings.fix: Drop or disable the MSAA option.
findings.gauge: LoL lists only modes the engine applies.

findings.title: Redundant and contradictory copy
findings.what: QUICK/QUICK and RANKED/RANKED chips; '· Light'; 'Ready in {t}' after accepting; the loading subtitle repeats the title.
findings.verifierNote: Chip duplication seen in my own shot.

findings.title: Team-header faction glyph colour fights the ally/enemy convention
findings.what: The faction glyph is tinted by faction, not by relation.
findings.fix: Tint by relation, or render in neutral chalk.
findings.gauge: LoL colours your side as ally throughout.

findings.title: Home ignores the last queue; the top bar ignores the emblem
findings.what: The hero CTA is the rotated feature, and the profile chip uses a generic user icon.
findings.evidence: src/ui/app.tsx:380 '<Icon name="user" />'; grep -c emblem src/ui/app.tsx = 0; the user icon is visible in closing2v_client_roles_1920_QUICK.png.
findings.gauge: The LoL top bar shows the player's icon.
